name: king_cobra_head_tongue
description: King cobra (Ophiophagus hannah): heavy olive #6b7a3a body, darker olive back #4f5a2a, thin pale cream chevron bands #e8e0a8 pointing toward the head and fading toward it, pale yellow throat #e8d890, large smooth head shields, small dark eye under a heavy brow, NARROW hood (barely wider than the neck; never the wide Naja disc). Close-up of the head and thick neck in profile facing right: big head shields, brow, eye, nostril, labial scales, long dark grey-pink forked tongue out and flicking (tips near (+370,+40)). Anchor centre; bbox x -405..+380, y -120..+237 (neck runs off the bottom-left).
